premise: Leo drops his wrench in the lander's shadow and it vanishes as if into ink — until the crew rover's headlights find it.
inspiration: Aesop's 'The Dog and the Shadow', where the dog loses its bone to a reflection, turned: the shadow doesn't keep anything; light gives it back.
lesson: What seems lost can just be waiting for some light.
learning: Shadows on the Moon are inky black, because there is no air to spread light into them.

en-US.title: The Blackest Shadow
en-US.text: The {lander:enter} {lander:go to pad} lander stood on the landing pad, with a long black shadow beside it. {man:enter} Leo {man:go to lander} was tightening a bolt on one of its legs. {sfx:clink} {man:face happy} Just as he finished, {lander:live} the lander's hatch swung open and its ladder clanked down. {man:wobble} Jolt! The wrench slipped from Leo's glove, floated slowly down… right into the shadow. {man:face surprised} [gasps] And vanished. Leo peered in. Nothing. {man:shake 0.4} He waved his glove in it. Nothing! It was black as ink. {man:face sad} [curious] On Earth, air spreads a little light into every shadow. But the Moon has no air, so its shadows are pitch black. Then the big {crew-rover:enter} crew rover came rumbling by. {sfx:rumble} {man:pulse} {crew-rover:live hold} It switched on its headlights and swung them into the shadow. There, glinting in the dust, lay the wrench! {man:face happy} {man:hop} Leo laughed. {lander:pulse} [playfully] And from then on, Leo tied his wrench to his belt.

es-ES.title: La sombra más negra
es-ES.text: El {lander:enter} {lander:go to pad} módulo lunar estaba en la plataforma, con su larga sombra negra al lado. {man:enter} Leo {man:go to lander} estaba apretando un tornillo de una de sus patas. {sfx:clink} {man:face happy} Justo cuando terminó, {lander:live} la escotilla del módulo se abrió y su escalerilla bajó con un clonc. {man:wobble} ¡Meneo! La llave inglesa se le escapó del guante, bajó flotando despacio… justo dentro de la sombra. {man:face surprised} [gasps] Y desapareció. Leo miró dentro. Nada. {man:shake 0.4} Movió el guante dentro. ¡Nada! Estaba negra como la tinta. {man:face sad} [curious] En la Tierra, el aire lleva algo de luz a cada sombra. Pero la Luna no tiene aire, así que sus sombras son negrísimas. Entonces pasó por allí el gran {crew-rover:enter} rover de tripulación. {sfx:rumble} {man:pulse} {crew-rover:live hold} Encendió los faros y los giró hacia la sombra. ¡Allí, brillando en el polvo, estaba la llave! {man:face happy} {man:hop} Leo se rió. {lander:pulse} [playfully] Y desde entonces, Leo se ata la llave al cinturón.

clink.prompt: a small metal wrench clinking on a metal bolt, two light taps

rumble.prompt: a big vehicle's heavy wheels rumbling slowly over gravel, deep and steady, muffled
